run_multinode_training: run multinode BEIT model training on SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
parse_submitit_args: parse command-line arguments for submitit-based BEIT finetuning with GPU, node, and partition options
submit_checkpoint_job: submit a resumable SLURM job with checkpoint support that requeues on timeout or preemption
setup_gpu_environment: configure GPU rank, local rank, world size, and output directory from submitit job environment
create_shared_folder: create a shared checkpoint directory under /checkpoint/{user}/experiments/slip for distributed training
